bnt_cr_spon.Description: Boston Naming Test: Number of spontaneously given correct responses

bnt_stimCues.Description: Boston Naming Test: Number of stimulus cues given

bnt_cr_withStimCue.Description: Boston Naming Test: Number of correct responses following a stimulus cue

bnt_phonCue.Description: Boston Naming Test: Number of phoenomic cues

bnt_cr_withPhonCue.Description: Boston Naming Test: Number of correct responses following a phoenomic cue

bnt_totalScore.Description: Boston Naming Test: Total Score= Total number correct sponteously+following stimulus cue+add credit for items preceding the first item passed

bnt_totalScore_std.Description: Boston Naming Test: Standard Z scores = (Total score-Age-normed Mean BNT score)/Age-normed SD
